method: Independent read of all five exact generated answers against their embedded source, user correction, schema and evidence fixtures, plus the canonical bug-report skill/playbook. The reviewer did not generate those answers.

No native-host skill-discovery, forced compaction or live attachment upload was exercised.

The revision corrects deletion to a link disappearing until reload, keeps user origin and agent not-run status, uses Problem/Planned from the fixture, retains required Component as missing and omits the unavailable Severity field. It explicitly disclaims live metadata/server validation.
